format: html

```{r}
install.packages("httr2")
library(httr2)
library(tidyverse)


college_request <- request("https://api.data.gov") %>% 
  req_url_path_append("ed") %>% 
  req_url_path_append("collegescorecard") %>% 
  req_url_path_append("v1") %>% 
  req_url_path_append("schools") %>% 
  req_url_query(
    api_key = "bXO3GF1dLY7SFNpaaJdWYq84DW0lKu379xIDWsMk",
    fields = "id,school.name,school.ownership",
    per_page = 100,
    page = 1
  )


college_response <- req_perform(college_request)

college_response


install.packages("janitor")

college_tbl <- college_response %>%
  resp_body_json(simplifyVector = TRUE) %>%
  pluck("results") %>%
  as_tibble()

college_tbl


```
